events.description: Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay, Ross Geller, and Rachel Green are planning to listen to something other than the current music.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is going to pay for agreeing to change the music tonight.
Rachel Green says the group should guess what Rachel Green's job-interview news is.
Chandler Bing says the fifth dentist has caved.
Chandler Bing says all the dentists are now recommending Trident gum.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green's interviewer loved Rachel Green.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green and Rachel Green's interviewer talked for about two and a half hours.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green and Rachel Green's interviewer have the same taste in clothes.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green went to camp with Rachel Green's interviewer's cousin.
Rachel Green says the job Rachel Green interviewed for is perfect for Rachel Green.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green can do the job well.
All friends say Rachel Green's interview news is great and wonderful.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green's interviewer told the funniest story.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green will tell Monica Geller and their friends the funny story from Rachel Green's interviewer.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and their friends will laugh at the interviewer's funny story.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and their friends should play poker.
Joey Tribbiani says the group should listen to Joey Tribbiani.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani, Chandler Bing, and Ross Geller talked earlier about whether the group should play poker.
Joey Tribbiani says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay might not want to play poker.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani, Chandler Bing, and Ross Geller will completely understand if Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay do not want to play poker.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing and their friends could play another game, such as Pictionary.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not know which other game to play.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Phoebe Buffay, and Rachel Green would like to give playing poker another try.
Phoebe Buffay and Rachel Green say Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller should give poker another try.
Ross Geller asks whether Rachel Green wants Ross Geller to shuffle the playing cards.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller's offer to shuffle the playing cards is OK to decline.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is going to try shuffling the playing cards herself.
